ops.title: P1.5 legacy VM-disk teardown: complete the hermes container cutover (verified dead set + decisions)
ops.body:
User directive 2026-07-18: "get rid of all the legacy stuff, and just have one script that does our new stuff." Today's hermes container cutover (note 49956842) left the whole VM-disk build/deploy path half-migrated and vestigial. Verified DEAD (no live consumer): bootstrap.sh is already container-native (275-281, no nixos.img consumer — the grep for nixos.img/result-hermes hits only build-hermes-image.sh + its own stale "so bootstrap stays unchanged" comment + CHANGELOG).

**Consolidation target:** ONE build path — `scripts/build-container-image.sh <flake-attr> <tag>` (written by P1 round 3), used for both `hermes-container-image hermes-agent:latest` and `vault-container-image vault:latest`.

**DELETE:**
- `scripts/build-hermes-image.sh` (legacy repart VM-disk builder → result-hermes/nixos.img)
- `.github/workflows/build-images.yml` (CI that built + published the repart image) — BUT FIRST port its **genericity guard** (secret-shaped-string closure scan; the `AGE-SECRET-KEY-1` 58-char body scan etc.) INTO build-container-image.sh so every local container build runs the secret-leak scan (user decision: "port guard into the script").
- `nixos/image.nix` (systemd-repart image module, imported only by mkImage)
- `nixos/scratch-login.nix` (scratch overlay for hermes-image-scratch)
- `scripts/deploy-vm.sh` (retired stub)

**EDIT:**
- `flake.nix`: remove outputs `hermes-image`, `hermes-image-scratch`, and the `mkImage` fn. KEEP `hermesModules` + `nixosConfigurations.hermes` (the container image `pkgs/hermes-agent-image/image.nix` derives the agent from `nixosConfigurations.hermes.config.services.hermes-agent`).
- `justfile`: drop `build-hermes-image` recipe; fix `deploy` recipe's hermes branch (currently → deploy-vm.sh); fix `redeploy` recipe comment referencing deploy-vm.sh as disk-replace fallback; add build recipe(s) calling build-container-image.sh (hermes + vault).
- `scripts/bootstrap.sh`: rewire the manual container recipe text (277-279) to call `./scripts/build-container-image.sh hermes-container-image hermes-agent:latest`.
- `scripts/redeploy.sh`: fix header comment referencing deploy-vm.sh; RESOLVE whether the hermes branch still does VM `nixos-rebuild switch`/dry-activate (VM-era) vs container reload — the implementer must determine the CURRENT live container-redeploy path and make redeploy.sh hermes match it (deploy-vm.sh:19 claimed "redeploy.sh hermes reloads the container").
- `nixos/common.nix`: strip the now-dead VM-boot/repart machinery (systemd-boot ESP seeding, growPartition, /nix-path-registration store-DB load) IF nix eval of nixosConfigurations.hermes + the container image still succeeds; else leave + note. (Risky Nix-graph surgery — verify eval on the builder VM at P2.)
- CHANGELOG entry; sweep DEPLOY.md/ARCHITECTURE.md/tests for deploy-vm.sh / hermes-image / nixos.img references.

**Verification:** nix-correctness (flake eval, container image still builds) checked on the builder VM at P2, not inline (host has no nix). Runs as its own change AFTER P1-vault ships (two logical commits: add vault node; remove dead hermes VM machinery). Plan: acct-12 `now-that-metal-is-tingly-planet.md`.
